title: Beam over the canoe, taken aboard, wand jabbed in Jim's ribs

tellings.quote: I remembered it being right over on like literally on top of us and it this beam came down around the canoe

plain: In 1976, on the Allagash Waterway, a river route through the Maine woods, a craft hung right on top of a canoe and a beam came down around it, according to Jim Weiner, who was in the canoe. Weiner says he was taken aboard and that a wand-like tool was jabbed into his ribs, an account he tells as one of the strange abduction details he believes the government will never disclose.
